title: Does what it's supposed to do!
text: Does what it's supposed to do!. It's great for breaking up large amounts of ground beef into smaller portions to sauté.  I haven't tried it on anything else yet but I'm sure it'll work for potatoes and other foods too.

product_metadata.title: Ourokhome Meat Chopper for Ground Beef, Stable Operation, Meat Cooking utensil for Hamburger Meat, Ground Turkey and Pork, Masher and Smasher for Potato, Puree, Sauce, Avocado and More, Navy.
features: ◑ Our patented design of meat chopper: Do you wish you had a meat masher like this: break meat efficiently, not break easily, not destroy your pans and pots, withstand high temperatures, have a more comfortable handle and be easy to clean. To solve these problems, we designed this meat breaker, The keywords of our meat smasher is power, efficient and comfortable. It will be the most useful kitchen gadgets in your kitchen.

◑ Ergonomic design of hamburger chopper: The shape of 5 blades is inspired by aircraft's engines. Curved blades increase the contact area between meat stirrer chopper and ingredients, which will effectively break up meat. The edge of blade is neat and smooth, which will not harming your pan. The back of handle is Non-slip design to prevent it from slipping, even if you have water or oil on your hand. The front of handle is smooth design that fits your palm better and is more comfortable to use.

◑ A versatile ground beef chopper: It's amazing how much kitchen work this little gadget can do: easily break up hamburger meat, ground meat or turkey for tacos, spaghetti sauce, burritos and anything with ground meat. Mash boiled egg for egg salad. Smashing potato, pumpkin and any other steamed veggies to puree. Crush tomato, strawberries and any other soft fruit to sauce. Chop avocado for guacamole. Even making dog food for your lovely dog. It can also be used in the kitchen for stirring.

◑ Superior and safe Materials: We have improved the material of our meat breaker. We use nylon and Glass Fiber for the mixing head , so that the whole potato masher is resistant to high temperatures (up to 450℉). The handle is made from nylon, all parts are BPA free. ◑ Easy use of our chopper and stirrer: We've been trying to make it easier for you, we designed a thumb rest on top of the handle for easy use, masher fast, more stable operation and save your labor.

◑ Easy clean and easy storage: the avocado masher is dishwasher safe. We designed a hole in the handle to hang on a kitchen hook. Or you can put it in your drawer, the angle of the handle will allow the meat crusher to place horizontally and avoid scrolling. ◑ Customer comes first: We value our customers and hope you will enjoy a pleasant shopping experience, we provide 365 days warranty, any question, just feel free to contact with us!
